prompts.stage:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production background for an ORIGINAL 2D one-on-one pixel-art fighting game called ASH HARBOR / 烬港斗魂, not a screenshot.
Primary request: create a beautiful empty side-view fighting arena: a rain-soaked Chinese harbor quay at midnight, dark indigo sky, distant layered pagoda roofs, a huge warm full moon partly obscured by clouds, steamship silhouettes, red lanterns under curved dock eaves, jade-green water reflecting gold light. The lower 30 percent is a wide completely unobstructed flat horizontal wet stone platform spanning the entire image. Platform ground contact line at 84 percent image height. No foreground object may obscure the fighting plane. Rich background detail, strong readable silhouette layers and atmospheric depth.
Style: authentic carefully hand-placed 1990s premium arcade pixel art, limited navy/teal/vermilion/gold palette, crisp clusters and dark outlines, no smooth 3D, no photorealism, no blur. Wide landscape 3:2 aspect ratio, 1536x1024. This will be downsampled to 384x256; compose broad clear masses.
No fighters, no people, no HUD, no letters, no logos, no watermark. The stage must feel like a finished original arcade fighting game.
prompts.jin:

Create ONE transparent PNG exactly 1536x1024 with EXACTLY 8 columns by 4 rows = 32 equally sized cells, each cell 192x256. No visible grid lines, no labels. Every cell contains exactly ONE full-body sprite of the SAME adult East Asian male fighter JIN, facing RIGHT in side-on three-quarter fighting view. Read left-to-right:
ROW 1: four consecutive idle breathing poses, then four consecutive advancing walk poses.
ROW 2: punch windup, straight punch fully extended, punch follow-through, punch recovery; kick windup, horizontal high side-kick fully extended, kick follow-through, kick recovery.
ROW 3: deep crouch, crouching guard, standing cross-arm guard, upper body recoiling from a hit; jump ascent with raised knee, airborne tuck, airborne kick, landing crouch.
ROW 4: palm energy attack charge, palm thrust, rising uppercut launch, rising uppercut at apex; forward rush strike, ultimate power-up spread stance, ultimate forward double-palm blast pose, victorious raised fist.
